Name: Nyapu's Portraits for Seasonal Outfits - East Scarp - Color Edit
Author: SmolNublet
Description:
[size=3]This mod changes all the portraits from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045]Seasonal Cute Character for East Scarp[/url] with those from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong[/url]. This is a continuation of my mod series to update seasonal outfit mods with color palette swaps of Nyapu's portraits.[/size]

[size=4]Installation:[/size][size=5]
[/size][size=2][size=2]1. Download [/size][size=2]Nyapu'sP(East Scarp 2.3.8) from the optional files in[/size][size=2] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong[/url][/size][size=2].
[/size][size=2]2. Replace the assets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] with those from Nyapu.[/size]
[size=2]3. Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045]Seasonal Cute Character for East Scarp[/url].
4. Manually download and unzip this mod.
5. Move the folder from this mod into your Mods folder and replace all files.[/size][/size]

[size=4]Thanks and Credit:
[/size][size=2]Big thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu/about-me]Nyapu[/url] for amazing portrait art and permissions to upload their work.
Big thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister/about-me]Poltergeister[/url] and all other artists involved for creating the amazing Seasonal Outfits mod. [/size]
